versions.body:
North Lamp paints signs, sets type, and keeps a lamp in the window on the days we are in.

Mail: Suite 210, 18 Harbor Street, Port Calder. That is a virtual address. The studio itself is a first-floor room on Quay Lane, when the stairs agree.

We do shop fronts, menus, and the occasional civic leaflet. We do not do political campaigns.

Recent work: a lettered awning for a fish bar, a series of library event posters, and a wedding invitation that used too much gold.

We do not publish a client list. If you saw a sign you liked, you can ask. If we made it, we will say so.
